name: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly to break the yolks, then mix in the shortening—you should have a loose mixture.
Mix in the brown sugar, milk, vanilla, and salt.
Mix the flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon, and oatmeal together in another bowl.
Mix the wet and dry mixes together to get a soft dough.
Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) for 15–20 minutes.
